resources.string: The virtual gamepad needs Shizuku for privileged access. Install the Shizuku app, start its service, then grant this app permission when prompted.
Each player is a controller of its own to every app: Joy-Con Virtual Gamepad 1, 2 and so on.
In the game\'s or emulator\'s controller settings, pick it for that player and map each button by pressing it.
On a handheld the built-in controller is usually listed first, so Player 1\'s gamepad may be the second controller.
The gamepad carries no motion. For gyro, pick Other (Motion) instead if the emulator reads DSU, or turn Motion on in Advanced alongside the gamepad.
